scope.filter: marketplace_account_id + operation_date BETWEEN from AND to (inclusive)

equivalentSql:
-- Dashboard-equivalent (PostgREST / Supabase)
-- Table: wb_finance
-- Filters: marketplace_account_id = '1'
--          operation_date >= '2025-12-20'
--          operation_date <= '2026-07-19'
-- Then in app: skip for_pay suffix; category ACQUIRING from suffix acquiring_fee;
--              SUM(ABS(amount))

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ABS(amount))::numeric, 2) AS sum_acquiring_fee
FROM wb_finance
WHERE marketplace_account_id = '1'
  AND operation_date >= '2025-12-20'
  AND operation_date <= '2026-07-19'
  AND (
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(wb_source_suffix), ''), split_part(source_key, ':', -1))
    = 'acquiring_fee'
  );
